title.value: The Machine Learning for Combinatorial Optimization Competition (ML4CO): Results and Insights
title.justification: The paper discusses the NeurIPS ML4CO Competition, offering results and insights on the use of Machine Learning in combinatorial optimization.
title.quote: The Machine Learning for Combinatorial Optimization Competition (ML4CO): Results and Insights

extractions.description: This paper presents the results and insights from the Machine Learning for Combinatorial Optimization (ML4CO) competition. The competition focused on applying machine learning to improve combinatorial optimization solvers by replacing heuristic components. It featured three tasks challenging participants to find the best feasible solution, produce the tightest optimality certificate, and give an appropriate solver configuration using datasets related to item placement, workload apportionment, and inventory routing.
